scenes.title: Chat, workflows, and findings share the project.

columns.heading: Chat
rows: Plan returns steps you can execute

columns.heading: Findings
rows: The recommended action stays with it

lines: In chat, Agent runs a skill. Plan returns steps you can execute.
The default scope is read-only. The agent analyses and recommends. It does not pretend a live change already happened.
Workflows enqueue a run when Azure or AWS is connected and the worker is up. Findings from those runs stay open, with the gate and the recommended action.

scenes.title: Architecture proposes. Approval records.
steps: Architecture keeps a Solution Architect run and the stage of that delivery.
A write-scoped skill may draft a change. It names the provider, the target, and the rollback.
Approval records the decision. The inbox does not execute the change.
scenes.approvalBody: Approving records the decision. The inbox does not execute the change.
lines: Architecture keeps a Solution Architect run, and the stage of that delivery.
You take a change into chat. Approval records the decision. The approvals inbox does not execute it.
